
A plan's task set is `tasks WHERE plan_doc = <doc>`. `lode task edit <id> --plan <ref>` links a task to the plan it executed when the plan did not mint it. `child_of` survives only for decomposing an oversized task into subtasks, with its guards applying to any task that has children. The depth cap of 2 is spent on task to subtask. Checkboxes are never execution state.
